final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, AVG(CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / sc.spanmin) AS a, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1) SELECT AVG(s1.a), AVG(s1.n), AVG(s1.a - s2.m) FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.m
